expiring.title: Expiring lots
expiring.periodAria: Period of the expiry warning list
expiring.hint: Expired lots and those expiring within {{days}} days, sorted by expiry date. Critical = at most 7 days (on the day of expiry itself the goods are still usable).
expiring.none: No expired or soon-to-expire lots in the next {{days}} days. 🎉
expiring.caption: Expired and soon-to-expire lots

title: Lot traceability
intro: Where did the lot come from, where is it now, what happened to it and which orders may be affected?
slashNotAllowed: Lot numbers containing “/” cannot be looked up here (the server treats the slash in the address as a path separator).
notFound: No lot “{{lot}}” found — no goods receipt, stock or movement carries this number.

tile.inboundTip: Total of the booked goods receipts of this lot

inbounds.title: Goods receipts
inbounds.none: No goods receipt recorded with this lot (e.g. legacy stock or stock from a correction).
inbounds.caption: Goods receipts of lot {{lot}}

stock.title: Current stock
stock.none: No stock left — the lot is used up or written off.
stock.caption: Current stock of lot {{lot}}

orders.title: Possibly affected orders
orders.hint: Derived from the pick bookings of the lot (pick list → lines with the same article and location). A pick line does not know the lot: if several lots were in the location, an order may have been supplied from another one.
orders.none: No order can be derived from this lot.
orders.caption: Orders for lot {{lot}}

lines.quantity: Line {{no}}: quantity must be a whole number between 1 and {{max}}.
lines.lotLength: Line {{no}}: the lot may have at most {{max}} characters.
lines.expiryInvalid: Line {{no}}: expiry date is not a valid date.
lines.expiryYear: Line {{no}}: expiry date must be after the year 2000.
lines.expiryPast: Line {{no}}: expiry date is in the past — new goods must not be expired.
lines.lotRequired: Line {{no}}: the article is tracked with lot and expiry date — enter the lot.
lines.expiryRequired: Line {{no}}: the article is tracked with lot and expiry date — enter the expiry date.
lines.lotExpiryConflict: Line {{no}}: lot {{lot}} appears in line {{other}} with a different expiry date — a lot has exactly one expiry date per location.
lines.none: Enter at least one line with article, target bin and quantity.
